items.headline: The valuation read is being pulled by sentiment
items.detail: The composite sits at the 18th percentile, but the sentiment axis is at 64 while the rest average 22 — the one dimension running hot.
items.framing: Everything is cheap except sentiment, which reads 64/100. That divergence is the story — it's how the exchange-flow build-up first became visible.
items.checkable: Each axis is a percentile of its own history; published weights on the Methods page.

items.headline: 2 new proven top-timers in 90 days
items.detail: Wallet(s) that just crossed the ROI+capital bar by selling a top at profit — a burst means distribution is starting.
items.framing: 2 wallet(s) newly qualified as smart money in 90d (sold a top at ≥5× ROI). Low count = quiet market; a spike is the tell.
items.checkable: First crossing of the ROI+capital bar per wallet, from the sale history.

items.headline: A spike in realized profit-taking
items.detail: Net realized profit today is 3.3σ from normal — coins are moving at a gain more than usual.
items.framing: Profit-taking spiked on-chain today (3.3σ). A behaviour read from what coins realised when they moved.
items.checkable: Realized P&L from the FIFO engine per moved coin.

items.headline: A whale shed 3.10M SPX in 7 days
items.detail: 0x8851…98fc distributed over the window, one of 2 whales net-selling.
items.framing: A large wallet distributed 3.10M SPX in 7 days. State it as a move off this wallet — it may be a split (see clustering), not a market sell.
items.checkable: Net balance change on a watched wallet over the last week of transfers.

items.headline: One wallet scooped 8 AEON over 2 days
items.detail: 0xb744…337d is the biggest net buyer of Project AEON over 30 days — 3.6 ETH ($9,596), well clear of the field.
items.framing: One wallet accumulated 8 AEON (~$9,596) on the market. Show the tornado / the city arcs — anyone can verify it.
items.checkable: Net marketplace buys minus sells per wallet over 30 days, from the public sale log.

items.headline: Long-dormant coins are waking up
items.detail: Liveliness 0.613 is 2.1σ up vs its month. Rising = old coins moving (distribution/rotation); falling = holders sitting still (accumulation).
items.framing: Older coins are starting to move — liveliness ticked up. Interesting "the patient money is stirring" angle; not a direction call.
items.checkable: Coin-days-destroyed vs coin-days-stored from the FIFO reconstruction.

items.headline: Smart money still net-selling (-24.4% over 12w)
items.detail: The 11-wallet cohort of proven top-timers (ROI ≥5×, still holding) holds 13.71M SPX. 4w -23.7% · 12w -24.4% · 26w -27.6%.
items.framing: Smart money hasn't started buying yet (-24.4% in 12w). Honest "not the bottom signal yet" read.
items.checkable: A recomputed cohort of wallets with realized ROI ≥5× that still hold ≥50k SPX; net flow of their combined balance.

items.headline: A whale added 700k SPX in 7 days
items.detail: 0x446b…27ba accumulated over the window, one of 3 whales net-buying.
items.framing: A large wallet accumulated 700k SPX in 7 days. Real, checkable buying by a big holder.

items.headline: Supply is spreading out of the top 100
items.detail: Top-100 share is 56.3% of holder supply, 1.7σ down vs its month.
items.framing: The largest 100 wallets gave up share this month (56.3%, 1.7σ). Broadening holder base — decentralising.
items.checkable: Top-100 addresses' share of tracked supply, from the transfer history.

items.headline: 3.39M SPX left in a day at a loss
items.detail: 2026-10-03: 29 wallets dropped below the 5k bar with 3.39M SPX, 1.8σ above the usual churn — loss-led (capitulation).
items.framing: A loss-led exit wave — the worrying kind: 29 wallets left 3.39M SPX underwater. Say "left/dropped below the bar", not "dumped".
items.checkable: Wallets whose balance fell below the 5k residency bar that day, split by exit vs entry price.

items.headline: Valuation: 18th percentile — Deeply undervalued
items.detail: The composite (six lenses on one 0–100 scale) reads 18 of its own history — deeply undervalued.
items.framing: SPX reads deeply undervalued today — 18th percentile of its own history. The one-line state of play.
items.checkable: Weighted percentile of six independent valuation lenses; weights published on Methods.

items.headline: Price is 0.86× the crowd's cost basis
items.detail: Spot $0.433 vs realized price $0.501 — the average holder is underwater (MVRV 0.86).
items.framing: Holders sit below their aggregate cost basis (MVRV 0.86). Historically an accumulation zone.
items.checkable: Market cap ÷ realized cap, from the FIFO cost-basis reconstruction.

items.headline: 52% of supply is in profit
items.detail: 52% of tracked supply is held above its on-chain cost basis today.
items.framing: 52% of supply is in profit. Low = capitulation zone, high = euphoria risk; a position read, not a signal.
items.checkable: Held coins with cost basis below spot, from the FIFO engine.
